en: Illustrated military scene showing Ottoman soldiers surrendering their rifles to Bulgarian troops after the capture of a fortress or city. A large pile of stacked rifles is in the foreground, guarded by Bulgarian soldiers in light-colored uniforms with bayonets fixed. Ottoman soldiers in darker uniforms and fezzes march past, some carrying a red flag with a white crescent and star. In the background are trenches or fortifications. At the top is printed text in old Bulgarian orthography. On the right, a Bulgarian soldier holds a banner with the Bulgarian coat of arms, the national colors, and celebratory text including the year 1913.
